result:
Landed in a new `src/filter/builder.rs`, a submodule of `linear` re-exported there; `src/filter.rs` gains only `mod builder; pub use builder::{Covariance, LinearKalmanFilterBuilder};` and a doc paragraph. New `tests/constructor_tests.rs` (19). DESIGN_NOTES.md updated; frozen files untouched.
Public API: `LinearKalmanFilterBuilder` reached by `LinearKalmanFilter::builder(&f, &h)` (F and H required, n/m inferred from their lengths, x0 defaults to zero, P0/Q/R required as full matrix, diagonal or scalar variance); `LinearKalmanFilter::constant_velocity(dims, dt, q, r)` and the same as a builder preset. Every path materialises row-major slices and calls `LinearKalmanFilter::new`, so validation stays in one place; builder-only errors are a missing piece (`BuilderIncomplete`), a wrong-length diagonal, and overflowing dimensions.
Easy: `linear` is one type in one file and construction is a separate concern, so the new submodule kept the numeric file the frozen tests exercise untouched; `new` already validates slices, so each helper only writes slices.
Hard: dimensions have to be inferred from slice lengths (`isqrt` for F, checked division for H), and P0 cannot default because zero P0 with zero Q makes the filter ignore every measurement forever, so only x0 defaults.
Unsure: "process-noise intensity" is read as acceleration noise, Q = q·[[dt³/3·I, dt²/2·I],[dt²/2·I, dt·I]]; Q = q·I is the other reading, and negative dt is rejected only through that Q going indefinite, so dt < 0 with q = 0 is accepted.
Verified: frozen 32, lib 105, new 19, doctests 14, `cargo build --all-targets` green, clippy clean in the touched files. Left alone: README.md still shows the removed `KalmanFilterBuilder` (already stale).
